summary: Thursday titles and first-frame pass: added 6 sourced 'thing in your hand' topics (Coca-Cola per drink, Uber per ride, Costco's $1.50 hot dog, the 10,000-bitcoin pizzas, McDonald's crew vs CEO pay, Super Bowl ad per second) and one title challenger to the weekly loop.
why: Agents are unpaused. The feed had 9 open topics. The six new ones score 7.26 to 8.81, beating several open ones; every figure was read on an SEC filing or the cited page. Titles with two contrasting figures held 41.3% stayed to watch against 35.7% (n=12 vs 40), which is enough for a loop test but not a recipe change.
